admin.title: Offline mode
admin.text: Devices that work offline here, and changes held for your decision.
admin.no_devices: No device works offline here yet.
admin.remove_text: It stops working offline at once and clears its offline data the next time it connects. Changes it still sends are held for you to decide.
admin.release_text: It is applied as your own change, with every check run again.
admin.discard_text: It is never applied. This cannot be undone.

mine.title: Offline devices
mine.text: Browsers and apps you set up to work offline. Remove one you lost or no longer use: it clears its offline data when it next connects.
mine.empty: You have not set up any device to work offline.
mine.remove_text: It stops working offline at once and clears its offline data the next time it connects.
